name: se.storytools.phonewand
description: Use phones as pointers for a shared screen. Connects to a Phone Wand relay and gives you every player's orientation, pointing direction, screen position and button presses, with events on the main thread.

samples.description: Draws each player's coloured cursor where they point, with their name, a ripple when they press the main button, and an arrow at the edge when they point off the screen.
